answer: Each identity must return a 90s live recording of local AC mains noise under a sable epoch nonce. Validators hash its spectral cipher and match peaks to regional grid maps; rack clones share one 60Hz wobble and collapse to a single seat. A 200-clone farm needs ~200 distinct substations (~$40/mo cross-city hosts each). Replay fails the mid-window karst chirp; missing chirp voids the epoch.
